title: Your desktop, organized
summary: Render one briefing as wallpaper, an HTML planner and a full report.

steps.title: 1 / Provide a structured briefing
steps.instruction: Use examples/daily_briefing.example.json to try the app without connecting an account.

steps.title: 2 / Read the generated dashboard
steps.instruction: Exams receive priority, followed by imminent assignments, important messages and recruiting.

steps.title: 3 / Open the local planner
steps.instruction: The HTML and Markdown outputs preserve the details and individual source links.

title: Know what is due next
summary: Show seven days of exams and 72 hours of actionable assignments.

steps.title: 1 / Review upcoming assessments
steps.instruction: Confirmed exams link to their verified review material; missing material falls back to the course source.

steps.title: 2 / Filter completed and expired work
steps.instruction: The real filter removes submitted work, expired assignments and work outside the 72-hour window.

steps.title: 3 / Keep the whole exam inventory
steps.instruction: An exam stays recorded even when it is outside the seven-day display window. Coverage remains partial until all sources are checked.

title: Reach cards with Option
summary: Hold Option to interact; double-tap Option to open the foreground planner.

steps.title: 1 / Leave the desktop click-through
steps.instruction: With Option released, the transparent overlay lets Finder receive your clicks.

steps.title: 2 / Hold Option and choose a card
steps.instruction: Highlighted rectangles use the renderer's actual hotspot coordinates. Each card has its own destination.

steps.title: 3 / Double-tap Option
steps.instruction: Open the full HTML planner in the foreground when another window covers the desktop. This is an interaction illustration, not a live screen recording.

title: See messages needing attention
summary: Show concise role, action and urgency summaries with honest source status.

steps.title: 1 / Supply reviewed message summaries
steps.instruction: The renderer accepts source, sender role, action, urgency and a safe source link.

steps.title: 2 / Read the compact message card
steps.instruction: The dashboard shows the action summary without placing the full email body on the wallpaper.

steps.title: 3 / Check source status
steps.instruction: A failed connection is displayed as partial or unavailable; it is not interpreted as an empty inbox.

title: Verify daily internship updates
summary: Parse real email formats and reconcile the headline count with unique job links.

steps.title: 1 / Configure Gmail read-only access
steps.instruction: Provide your own OAuth client and complete consent. Scheduled collection searches the SWE List sender; this demo uses a local mail fixture.

steps.title: 2 / Reconcile every posting link
steps.instruction: The actual parser extracts company, role and application URL from the fictional update, then verifies the count.

steps.title: 3 / Reject incomplete results
steps.instruction: Changing the fixture headline to five while retaining four links makes validation fail; the job queue must not treat it as a complete update.

title: Prepare applications deliberately
summary: Keep unknown requirements, manual decisions and confirmed preparation distinct.

steps.title: 1 / Build a local preparation queue
steps.instruction: Only count-verified opportunities enter the queue. Title rules and stable fingerprints remove exclusions and duplicates.

steps.title: 2 / Review job requirements
steps.instruction: Tiny Labs remains pending. No eligibility or application-limit result is invented just to mark a role prepared.

steps.title: 3 / Start an interactive review
steps.instruction: The application-center card creates a user-visible review request. An application can only be recorded as submitted after separate confirmation and an official success state.

title: Add your campus resources
summary: Enable local JSON plugins to add useful HTTPS resource links.

steps.title: 1 / Copy the example plugin
steps.instruction: Create a local JSON file under plugins/ and give it a unique identifier.

steps.title: 2 / Load the enabled resource
steps.instruction: The demo enables a copied plugin inside its own workspace and runs the real plugin loader.

steps.title: 3 / Find it in the planner
steps.instruction: The generated HTML planner contains the campus resource link. Plugins are data-only and do not execute arbitrary code.

title: Connect another local tool
summary: Expose verified opportunities through a read-only loopback API.

steps.title: 1 / Start the service
steps.instruction: Point the API at a verified report. It binds only to the local loopback interface.

steps.title: 2 / Fetch verified opportunities
steps.instruction: The demonstration feeds HTTP requests into the real handler using a generated report. It uses in-memory transport, without opening a server port.

steps.title: 3 / Keep the integration read-only
steps.instruction: Mutation requests receive an explicit 405 response. The service is not an unattended application-submission endpoint.

title: Create a factual resume draft
summary: Select and reorder supplied experience for a local job description.

steps.title: 1 / Supply your facts and the job text
steps.instruction: Use a private JSON profile and a local job-description file. The included profile is entirely fictional.

steps.title: 2 / Inspect the selected facts
steps.instruction: The generator ranks existing skills and bullets by overlap with the job description. It does not rewrite experience or call an external model.

steps.title: 3 / Review the PDF
steps.instruction: Open the generated draft and check content and layout before using it. This page is the actual output of the sample run.

title: Refresh with visible evidence
summary: Plan bounded collection, preserve source failures and verify presentation separately.

steps.title: 1 / Generate the refresh plan
steps.instruction: Inspect the plan before collecting. Announcements still need checking even when a cached syllabus is reusable.

steps.title: 2 / Finalize locally once
steps.instruction: After authenticated collection, local-only mode prepares the queue and renders. Wallpaper application is a separate explicit flag.

steps.title: 3 / Verify or preserve last good
steps.instruction: The renderer hashes the image used by its hotspot manifest. Recovery logic is tested with isolated fixtures; this video does not claim to verify a live lock screen.
